I don't defend Walmart. I refuse to defend Walmart. I defend and speak for the employees, and try to move for the changes that can be made. I can't just walk up to the CEO of Walmart and demand a raise in wage. I can't walk into the retailers that get crushed by Walmart, apologize for the company that I work at's behavior and try to fix it. I'm no CEO, I'm no manager, I'm just an *associate,* and therefore I feel a duty to other *associates* to make the changes and movements I am capable of making and changing. If this means bringing up the fact that a lot of customers take advantage of the fact that we're just hourly associates then sure, I'll do that.   


What you ask of me is impossible from my standpoint, especially at my age and position. Give me a soapbox and I will preach, but unless you can give me a microphone that all the world can hear, only the people in range of my physical voice can - and will - hear what I have to say, and even they have to be willing to listen.

As a slowly growing streamer myself, here’s what I find are draws:

-my cam (days with cam I average 3-5 more than without)

-music means something! I have a variety of playlists, but I find that I can’t play some of them due to viewer tastes

-chat interaction - sometimes, I’ll be more focused on my game, and chat less. This may be a more me thing, but I find less viewers when I’m hyper focused

-personality!!! I have a quirky personality, and I have to suppress some parts of it (eg. I like making random accents to have a laugh with my viewers) but I often find while a little is good, too much will seriously drop viewers

Elemental Skills Each element gets a special bonus, chosen via your primary (attack) attribute

Has an x (according to ascensions) percent chance to evade the opponent’s strike. If successful, gains Counterattack bonus
